headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 10 November 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL rankings at $41.6 billion, followed by Base at $5.7 billion and BSC at $5.1 billion. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest 24-hour DEX volume at $1.05 billion, while Tether and Circle USDC generated the largest protocol fees. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoin circulation at $176 billion and $70 billion respectively, with several smaller stablecoins showing peg deviations. Base and Arbitrum One hold the top L2 TVS positions at $13.9 billion and $9.1 billion.

sections.title: Chains & TVL
bullets: Ethereum ranks first with $41.62 billion TVL.
Base holds second position at $5.71 billion TVL.
BSC and Solana follow at $5.10 billion and $5.05 billion TVL.

sections.title: DEX & fees
bullets: Uniswap V3 leads DEX volume with $1.05 billion in 24 hours.
Uniswap V4 and Kalshi follow with $824 million and $822 million.
Tether and Circle USDC top fees at $16.6 million and $6.7 million in 24 hours.

sections.title: Stablecoins
bullets: USDT circulates at $176.23 billion and USDC at $70.27 billion.
USDS, USDe and DAI rank next at $5.39 billion, $4.96 billion and $4.66 billion.
Falcon USD, apxUSD and FRAX show peg deviations between 0.5% and 1%.

sections.title: L2s
bullets: Base leads L2 TVS at $13.87 billion with OP Stack.
Arbitrum One follows at $9.07 billion TVS.
Hyperliquid (L3) and Polygon PoS hold $6.23 billion and $3.76 billion TVS.

sections.title: Security
bullets: Ankr Bridge incident on 9 November resulted in $304,500 loss.
ACryptoS and TENDRIL incidents reported on 8 and 5 November.
Mercado Bitcoin recorded $40 million loss on 2 November.
